eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following areas: Beauregard, LA; at 2:59 PM on AUG 22, 2023 Effective until 2:59 PM AUG 23, 2023. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Beauregard Parish Sheriff's Office is alerting residents along Hwy 110W between Singer and Merryville to a dangerous situation. There is currently a wildfire along Highway 110W near the town of Merryville. It isn't contained as of yet and we are asking residents between Singer and Merryville along Hwy 110W to be vigilant and aware and be prepared to evacuate if necessary. This isn't a mandatory evacuation order but one may be issued in the best future so please be aware. We will update as soon as possible but for the meantime please be prepared to evacuate. If you choose to evacuate please contact our office at 337-463-3381 and let us know who you are, where you're evacuating from and a good number to reach you at. Please be prepared to evacuate if necessary.
